title: Telephone telepathy experiments

tellings.quote: virtually everyone is about 85% of the population that you can do experiments on that have done lots and I'm pretty sure it's real

plain: The scientist Rupert Sheldrake says that people can sense who is calling them on the phone before they pick up, a kind of telepathy that he says he has tested in many experiments. He tells Michels that "virtually everyone," about 85% of the people he can test, shows the effect, and that he is "pretty sure it's real," which would mean minds can reach each other beyond the known senses.
